subject: Expansion: Provisioning additional project keys and staged enablement for BrightBridge
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion: Provisioning additional project keys and staged enablement for BrightBridge

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the great conversation yesterday. Per your ask, I put together a short plan for provisioning additional API keys and onboarding three new internal projects you mentioned (RiskScore, AccountRecon, and OutreachBot). The goal is to let your product teams ship safely while keeping usage predictable during the quarter.

High-level proposal (attached):
- Issue scoped API keys per project (separation by namespace + rate class)
- Staged enablement: pilot (1 team) -> rollout (2 more teams) over 6 weeks
- Burst capacity guardrails and prefunded commit for month 1 of rollout

I attached a draft mutual action plan (BBF-MAPlan-v2.pdf) and SKU/pricing sheet with quantity bands. Quick asks from your side so we can finalize:
1) Confirmation of the three project names and intended production dates
2) Who in procurement will sign the amendment for the additional reserved units?
3) A preferred date/time for a 30-min technical sync with your infra lead (we recommend Lauren + Markus from our side).

If that looks good I can loop in our contracts specialist and send a tracked amendment with the staged capacity add-on.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: BBF-MAPlan-v2.pdf (pdf), BBF-sku-and-pricing-DEC2026.xlsx (xlsx)

Ben —

Thanks for the plan and the attachments. Quick answers:
- Project names confirmed: RiskScore, AccountRecon, OutreachBot.
- Target production dates: RiskScore Jan 18, AccountRecon Feb 1, OutreachBot Feb 15.
- Procurement contact is procurement@brightbridge.com (they're looped). Ian (cc'd) will own the technical side.

We have one ask on the SKU sheet: can we get a month-by-month burn estimate for the pilot (RiskScore) based on the 10k monthly active sessions assumption? Procurement also asked to see draft contract language for the staged commitment (we can mark up).

Available for a quick tech sync Thursday 12/10 at 10am PT if that works for your team.

—Alyssa

Ben / Lauren / Markus —

Thanks for the invite, sent. Quick technical notes ahead of the call so we use time efficiently:
- RiskScore will need a separate namespace and a stricter rate class (low-latency inference, lots of short requests).
- AccountRecon wants batched embeddings for nightly reconciliation; can we provision a batch queue and quota?
- OutreachBot will be non-prod at first; we'd like to discourage cross-environment key reuse.

I'll bring sample traffic patterns and a short diagram of our infra. If you have a recommended header or claim to include in the key payload for project provenance, please share before the sync.

Thanks,
Ian

Team —

Recap from Thursday's call and agreed next steps (short):
1) Pilot configuration (RiskScore):
   - Issue scoped key with high-priority rate class; we will pre-warm KV caches for the pilot window (Jan 18–Feb 17).
   - Send month/day burn estimate to Alyssa by Monday 12/14 (Monica to own consumption model).
2) AccountRecon:
   - Provision batch queue and a separate key for nightly jobs (target Feb 1 prod).
   - Markus to check embedding-cost optimization (quantization guidance).
3) OutreachBot:
   - Non-prod keys only until acceptance tests pass; 2-week staging window before Feb 15.
4) Contract & procurement:
   - Monica will upload tracked amendment to HubSpot and procurement@brightbridge.com can mark up. Target signature by Dec 22 to secure reserved burst units.

Action owners: Monica (amendment + HubSpot upload), Lauren (key template + header claim suggestion), Markus (embed/cost guidance), Ben (deal timeline and exec summary).

I'll attach the final MA plan and the SKU sheet with the burn scenarios in HubSpot after Monica posts her version.

Ben
